newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Citibank basic capital at CZK 1.475 bln.
newsitem.headline: Czech Citibank basic capital at CZK 1.475 bln.

text.p: Total basic capital of Prague-based Citibank a.s. totalled 1.475 billion crowns, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
Earlier in the day, the central bank released a list of domestic and foreign banks in the Czech Republic which showed Citibank's basic capital at 600 million crowns.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment or clarification of the discrepency.
Citibank established its operations in the Czech Rpeublic in 1991.
